messages:
Ryan S: Hey team — accelerator partner (SeedSpark) asking for $25k in credits for a 6-month POC + reference. They're a 10-person startup, building in EU, want private/dedicated deployment after POC. Need deal-desk approval for promotional credits & startup discount.
Alex P: Quick Q — what does 'dedicated' mean here? Any committed spend? We usually require a 3mo minimum commit for Dedicated.
Ryan S: No commit yet. They want credits to prove latency and embedding quality. Use case: real-time chat, ~200 rps spikes, heavy embeddings. Asked about support SLA.
Alex P: Suggestion: $25k credits + 15% off first-year reserved capacity if they convert within 6 months. Aligns incentives.
Jordan L: FYI deal desk — pre-reqs: customer size, ARR estimate, reference commitment. Send me the 1-pager and their expected conversion timeline.
Ryan S: Adding the pitch deck: https://redwood-share.example/seed-spark-deck
Maya T: From finance — credits OK but we need a monthly cap to avoid abuse. Propose monthly cap of $6k with overage alert + auto-block. Also need cost-center tagging.
DealDeskBot: New promo request submitted by Ryan S for SeedSpark. Request ID: DD-20260321-77. Status: pending review.
Jordan L: I can approve credits conditional on: 1) written commitment to be a reference, 2) signed POC MSA, 3) completed security questionnaire. Need legal + security signoff before credits are issued.
Sam K: Security checklist items: EU data hosting confirmation, SOC 2 status, encryption-at-rest, KMS integration, and IP clauses. Can they complete the questionnaire within 7 days?
Ryan S: Founder confirmed they'll complete Q within 48 hours. I'll send it now.
Alex P: For contract language use: ```"$25,000 in platform credits to be applied over 6 months; unused credits expire. Conversion incentive: 15% discount on first-year Dedicated commit if executed within 6 months."``` Keep the POC scope limited.
Jordan L: I'll draft the conditional approval note. One more — is this allowed under the accelerator program rules? We restrict to early-stage (<$2M ARR) typically.
Maya T: They're pre-revenue so fits. But credits >$20k require exec sponsor for exception. Jordan, route to RevOps manager please.
Jordan L: Routing to @Maya T and @Sam K for final signoffs. @DealDeskBot please mark requires-exec-approval.
DealDeskBot: Request DD-20260321-77 status updated: requires-exec-approval.
Ryan S: Thanks — pinged founder to sign questionnaire and MSA. Will loop back with answers in 24-48h.
Sam K: Once Q is returned, legal will redline MSA. Expect 2 business days for initial review.
Alex P: Add technical POC scope: max sequence length 2k, KV cache enabled, disable long-term request logging for any PII data.
Ryan S: Noted — I'll add scope to the 1-pager and send updated deck.
Jordan L: Conditional approval granted pending exec signoff + signed MSA + completed security questionnaire. I'll push formal approval after exec signoff.
Maya T: Tagging finance for visibility: @Finance. We'll track credit consumption under a new cost center and alert on usage thresholds.
Ryan S: Great — thanks everyone :tada:
